title.en: How to Get a DeepSeek API Key (2026 Step-by-Step Guide)
title.zh: 如何获取 DeepSeek API Key（2026 逐步指南）

excerpt.en: DeepSeek offers competitive pricing and strong reasoning models. Here's exactly how to create your DeepSeek API key, check pricing, and make your first request.
excerpt.zh: DeepSeek 提供有竞争力的定价和强大的推理模型。本文教你如何创建 DeepSeek API Key、查看定价，并发送第一个请求。

en: DeepSeek has become one of the fastest-growing AI API providers in 2026, with search interest increasing over 60% month-over-month. For a comprehensive overview, [[guide:deepseek-api-key-complete-guide|the complete DeepSeek API guide]] covers pricing, models, and use cases. Current V4 endpoints — deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro — remain cheaper than many international alternatives, especially in idle hours.

DeepSeek is particularly strong in reasoning tasks, code generation, and multilingual support. As one of the leading [[guide:china-ai-api-keys-complete-guide|Chinese AI API providers]], DeepSeek offers capabilities that rival Western alternatives. If you're looking for a cost-effective API with strong reasoning capabilities, DeepSeek is worth serious consideration.
zh: DeepSeek 已成为 2026 年增长最快的 AI API 供应商之一，搜索热度月增长超过 60%。[[guide:deepseek-api-key-complete-guide|DeepSeek API 完整指南]]涵盖了定价、模型和使用场景的全面介绍。当前 V4 接口 deepseek-v4-flash 和 deepseek-v4-pro 仍比许多国际替代方案便宜，空闲时段更明显。
DeepSeek 在推理任务、代码生成和多语言支持方面表现突出。作为 [[guide:china-ai-api-keys-complete-guide|中国 AI API 供应商]]中的佼佼者，DeepSeek 的能力可与西方替代方案媲美。如果你在找一个性价比高且推理能力强的 API，DeepSeek 值得认真考虑。

heading.zh: 第 1 步：注册 DeepSeek 账号

en: Go to the DeepSeek developer platform and sign up with your email or phone number. Email verification is required. The registration process is straightforward and typically takes under two minutes.
DeepSeek accepts both international and Chinese phone numbers for verification, making it accessible to developers worldwide.
zh: 前往 DeepSeek 开发者平台，使用邮箱或手机号注册。需要验证邮箱，整个注册流程很简单，通常不到两分钟。
DeepSeek 支持国际和中国手机号验证，全球开发者都可以使用。

heading.zh: 第 2 步：生成 API Key

en: After logging in, navigate to the API Keys section in your dashboard. Click 'Create API Key' and give it a descriptive name. Copy the key immediately — like most API providers, DeepSeek only shows the full key once.
Store the key in a secure location such as an environment variable or a secret management system. Never hardcode it in your source files.
zh: 登录后进入后台的 API Keys 页面，点击「Create API Key」，给 Key 起一个描述性的名字。立即复制保存——和大多数 API 供应商一样，DeepSeek 只显示一次完整 Key。
将 Key 存储在安全位置，如环境变量或密钥管理系统。不要硬编码在源代码中。

heading.en: Step 3: Add Credits to Your Account

en: DeepSeek uses a prepaid model. Before making API calls, you need to add credits to your account. The platform supports various payment methods including Alipay and WeChat Pay.
New users may receive a small amount of free credits upon registration, which is enough for testing. For production use, add credits based on your expected usage.
zh: DeepSeek 采用预付费模式。在调用 API 之前，需要先为账户充值。平台支持支付宝、微信支付等多种支付方式。
新用户注册后可能会获得少量免费额度，足够用于测试。生产使用时，根据预期用量充值即可。

heading.en: Step 4: Make Your First API Request
heading.zh: 第 4 步：发送第一个 API 请求

en: DeepSeek's API is OpenAI-compatible, which means you can use the same SDK and request format. This is common among Chinese AI platforms — for instance, [[guide:kimi-k3-api-key-setup-2026|the latest Kimi K3 setup guide]] follows the same pattern. Simply change the base URL and API key. zh: DeepSeek 的 API 兼容 OpenAI 格式，意味着你可以使用相同的 SDK 和请求格式。这在国内 AI 平台中很常见——例如 [[guide:kimi-k3-api-key-setup-2026|最新的 Kimi K3 接入指南]]也遵循同样的模式。只需修改 base URL 和 API Key 即可。以下是最小示例：

caption.zh: 使用 OpenAI Python SDK 调用 DeepSeek API 的最小示例

en: DeepSeek's pricing is still one of its main advantages after the August 2026 update. V4 Flash peak cache-miss input/output is ¥3.0/¥9.0 per 1M tokens; idle hours are half. See [[guide:deepseek-v4-models-pricing|the V4 Flash vs Pro pricing guide]] for cache rates, peak windows, and Pro prices.

Check the official pricing page for the most up-to-date rates, as pricing can change. If you're comparing options, [[guide:how-to-get-kimi-api-key|learn more about Kimi K3]] — another leading Chinese AI model with an ultra-long context window. Input and output tokens are priced separately, and cache-hit input is much cheaper than cache-miss input.
zh: DeepSeek 的定价在 2026 年 8 月调价后仍是主要优势之一。V4 Flash 高峰缓存未命中输入/输出为 ¥3.0/¥9.0 / 百万 tokens，空闲价减半。缓存费率、高峰窗口和 Pro 价格见 [[guide:deepseek-v4-models-pricing|V4 Flash 与 V4 Pro 定价指南]]。
建议查看官方定价页面获取最新价格，因为定价可能会有变化。如果你在对比选项，可以[[guide:how-to-get-kimi-api-key|了解 Kimi K3 的详细信息]]——另一个领先的中文 AI 模型，拥有超长上下文窗口。输入和输出 token 分别计价，缓存命中输入远低于缓存未命中。

answer.en: DeepSeek API is not free, but new users may receive a small amount of free credits. The paid pricing is very competitive compared to other providers.
answer.zh: DeepSeek API 不是免费的，但新用户可能会获得少量免费额度。付费定价相比其他供应商非常有竞争力。

question.en: Is DeepSeek API compatible with OpenAI SDK?
question.zh: DeepSeek API 兼容 OpenAI SDK 吗？

answer.en: Yes, DeepSeek's API is OpenAI-compatible. You can use the OpenAI SDK by simply changing the base URL to https://api.deepseek.com and using your DeepSeek API key.
answer.zh: 是的，DeepSeek 的 API 兼容 OpenAI 格式。你只需将 base URL 改为 https://api.deepseek.com 并使用 DeepSeek API Key，就可以使用 OpenAI SDK。

question.en: Can international developers use DeepSeek API?
question.zh: 国际开发者可以使用 DeepSeek API 吗？

answer.en: Yes. DeepSeek accepts international phone numbers for registration and supports multiple payment methods. The API documentation is available in both English and Chinese.
answer.zh: 可以。DeepSeek 支持国际手机号注册，并支持多种支付方式。API 文档同时提供英文和中文版本。
